subject: SOC 2 Type II report, bridge letter, and Trust Portal access
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Emily Chou <emily.chou@healthsync.com>
Cc: Markus Berg <mberg@healthsync.com>
Date: 2026-03-13T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Quick recap + SOC 2 / Trust Portal next steps

Hi Emily —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our discovery: HealthSync is evaluating Redwood for clinical NLP features in your patient-facing workflows. Key asks you called out:
- SOC 2 Type II report and any bridge letter for the period after the last report
- Trust Portal access so your security team can review evidence and config
- Confirmation on GDPR/HIPAA posture and any required DPA language
- A vendor security questionnaire (we can either fill your form or provide our security pack)

Next steps I promised:
1) Share our most recent SOC 2 Type II and a short bridge-letter stub — attaching a security overview now.
2) Open a Trust Portal request for HealthSync (link to request below).
3) Loop in our security/ops lead if you need an SSO or deeper evidence pull.

I attached: redwood_security_overview.pdf. I can also send the full SOC 2 Type II and a formal bridge letter — will do so once we confirm the scope (public cloud production only).

Are you able to share the vendor security questionnaire now (or should I start with our standard pack)? Also copying procurement if they want the SOC artifacts for review.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0134

From: Emily Chou <emily.chou@healthsync.com>

Subject: Re: Quick recap + SOC 2 / Trust Portal next steps

Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the recap, that captures the call well. Procurement is copied. A few clarifications:
- We need the SOC 2 Type II report covering fiscal 2025 and a bridge letter if your most recent report ends before our contract start date.
- Trust Portal access: we prefer read-only access so our security team can look through evidence and control mappings.
- We will upload our vendor security questionnaire (VSAQ) to your portal if possible; otherwise please fill out our spreadsheet.
- Can you confirm whether Redwood signs a standard DPA with HIPAA clauses? We handle PHI in scope, so that matters for us.

Can you send the SOC 2 and bridge letter PDFs to procurement@healthsync.com and provide the Trust Portal request link?

Regards,
Emily Chou
Director of Security & Privacy | HealthSync Inc.
emily.chou@healthsync.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>

Cc: Markus Berg <mberg@healthsync.com>

Emily / procurement team —

Thanks — attaching the formal SOC 2 Type II (Redwood_SOC2_TypeII_2025.pdf) and a bridge-letter stub (bridge_letter_2026-03-13.pdf). The SOC covers our hosted API and Dedicated product; the bridge letter notes continuity of controls through the gap period.

Trust Portal: please use this request link to request read-only access for your security reviewers: https://trust.redwood.ai/portal/healthsync-request-4821. Once you submit the request, our security admin reviews and grants access (we typically grant within 24 business hours for purchaser-validated requests).

DPA/HIPAA: Redwood offers a standard DPA with HIPAA BA terms for customers handling PHI. I'll have legal/ops confirm exact clause language — copying Aditya (security ops) on this thread to confirm and start the DPA conversation.

If you prefer, we can also complete your VSAQ directly. If you upload it to the portal, we will fill it out there.

Attachments: Redwood_SOC2_TypeII_2025.pdf, bridge_letter_2026-03-13.pdf

Best,
Marissa Cole
